Name: The Cosmic Shack
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
[center][i]Do you enjoy the wonders of the Cosmos?
Do you like witnessing the vastness of space?
Do you wish to see the stars of the Stardew Sky?
...Then, visit the Cosmic Shack!
[/i]
[i]The Cosmic Shack... because we all need more Space![/i][/center]

To get to the Cosmic Shack, you must first embark on a voyage to Ginger Island and enter Mr Qi's Walnut Room. You'll find a passage on the right of the room that will lead you to the Cosmic Shack. Say hi to HoloMaru while you enjoy the exhibition.

Do you like the interface in the screenshots? Then try my other: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14027]Sakura Interface Redux[/url]!

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/699981232758325312/1018933806289399968/requirements.png[/img]﻿
This mod requires:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9633]Extra Map Layers[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14493]MEEP[/url]﻿


[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/699981232758325312/1072827008695935016/About.png[/img][/center]
If you want to talk about mod making, anything Stardew-related or just chat, feel free to message me on Nexus, ping me in the Stardew Valley Discord [i]TheFrenchDodo#7155[/i] or join the [url=https://discord.gg/sdveastscarp]East Scarp Discord server[/url]!

If you enjoy my mods, feel free to buy me a coffee on[url=https://ko-fi.com/thefrenchdodo] Ko-fi[/url]!

Check out my other mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Creative Differences - Rodney a new NPC for East Scarp[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14027]Sakura Interface Redux[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13909]Townsfolk posters[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13756]Horse to Ostrich[/url]


The V1 of this mod was created in 48 hours during the Stardew Valley Mod Jam of 2023 and it includes 3 of the imposed themes: Voyage, Constellation & Boom.

[b]Future updates I have in mind:[/b]
- New pictures in the exhibit
- A few books to read
- A quest to access the shack and maybe expand it.
- If you have any suggestions, let me know in the Posts tab.﻿

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/699981232758325312/1018933805274378270/credits.png[/img]﻿

Some of the pictures in the exhibit were created using the [url=https://deep-fold.itch.io/space-background-generator]Space Background Generator[/url] and the [url=https://deep-fold.itch.io/pixel-planet-generator]Pixel Planet Generator[/url] by [url=https://deep-fold.itch.io/]Deep-Fold[/url].
A special thank to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/79440738]DecidedlyHuman[/url] for their support regarding the use of their amazing framework [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14493]MEEP[/url].
Thank you as well to Kami, Jessie, Nova, Lore, Keeper, Desty, Rex, Clown, Dara, Squeaks & Axell who either gave me some ideas for the constellations, endured me posting about the Cosmic Shack all weekend or just for being cool human beings and awesome friends.
